method: WCAG sRGB relative luminance; (lighter + 0.05) / (darker + 0.05). Raw floating-point ratios determine pass/fail; no rounding before comparison.
scope: Opaque CSS token pairs only; text >= 4.5:1, focus >= 3:1. Includes terminal canvas and terminal input. A is reported without modification. This does not assess opacity, compositing, or rendered component usage.
